description: This file contains library functions related to git bundle management, including functions to display pack data from a git bundle and check the object count within a bundle.

methods.name: convert_bundle_to_pack
methods.description: Reads the data from a git bundle, bypassing headers, and outputs the pack data.

methods.name: test_bundle_object_count
methods.description: Checks the count of objects in a git bundle, optionally fixing thin packs.
